name: Ibigawa (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ibigawa town emblem in blue, purple and light blue: two stylised human figures in blue and purple with a light blue swirl.
history: Municipal flag of Ibigawa, a town in Gifu Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 1 July 2005.
